title: Surprising Collaboration: David Choe's Parents Join Mangchi Vocal Track
editorial_title: Mangchi vocal session: family rehearsal, coaching, playback, and reactions
summary: A 5:20 mixed rehearsal timeline of spoken coaching, short religious vocal phrases, playback, applause, laughter and feedback. The session corrects and varies a Lord-is-King line, practices together with chorus/background voices, mentions an unidentified speaker’s dad wanting another practice, uses unseen wear/hold instructions, repeats brief Hallelujah/Jesus/everything/love vocals, and requests line-by-line/one-more/slower delivery. The opening and one King/made phrase remain damaged. Publisher-provided David Choe/parents/Mangchi context stays metadata only. No complete lyric, theology, studio setup, final take, release status, named voice or enrollment window is invented.
